newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOXING-ESPINOSA STOPS HIRANAKA TO KEEP WBC FEATHERWEIGHT CROWN.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-ESPINOSA STOPS HIRANAKA TO KEEP WBC FEATHERWEIGHT CROWN.

text.p: Luisito Espinosa of the Philippines stopped Japanese challenger Nobutoshi Hiranaka in the eighth round to retain his World Boxing Council (WBC) featherweight title on Saturday.
Espinosa, 29, outclassed Hiranaka from the outset of the fight, stinging the ninth-ranked challenger with right straight-left hook combinations that swelled Hiranaka's right eye nearly closed.
Mexican referee Guadalupe Garcia halted the fight 32 seconds into the eighth round after Espinosa smothered the nearly helpless Hiranaka with a barrage of blows.
"My left hooks hit the target very well and I thought in the third round that I could win," said Espinosa, adding that he thought Garcia should have stopped the fight earlier.
It was the third title defence for Espinosa, a Manila native who sometimes fights under the name of Luisito Koizumi.
He extended his record to 40 victories, including 21 by knockout, against seven losses.
Hiranaka (16-2) failed in his second shot at a world title following his defeat in August 1995 by World Boxing Association (WBA) featherweight champion Eloy Rojas of Venezuela.
Saturday's fight was so one-sided that all three American judges -- Chuck Hassett, Rudy Ortega and Terry Smith -- had scored it 70-63 in favour of Espinosa by the end of the seventh round.
